verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI documents native MCP client support: configuring MCP servers in ~/.gemini/settings.json to add custom tools, and using MCP servers for capabilities like Imagen/Veo/Lyria media generation. This is first-party documented functionality directly matching the story. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration specifically of MCP tool usage (community evidence focuses on general agentic performance, not MCP integration specifically).
